title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at EY, Zapata Quantum, IQM, Sparrow Quantum, and Symmatrics - Quantum Computing Report
gist: A roundup of quantum-industry appointments. EY hired former HSBC quantum lead Philip Intallura as Global Quantum Leader, Zapata Quantum added Peter Shor and three other academics to its Scientific Advisory Board, IQM hired IBM veteran Voica Radescu for commercial partnerships, Sparrow Quantum named founder Peter Lodahl CEO, and Symmatrics added ex-ODNI/CIA executive Andrew Hallman as an adviser.

themes.theme: Enterprise and quantum-safe advisory talent moves

insights.claim: EY appointed Dr. Philip Intallura as Partner, Global Quantum Leader. He previously led HSBC's quantum technology program, taking it from exploratory research into operational and strategic banking workflows. At EY he will focus on enterprise quantum-safe migration, risk advisory and application pilots in financial services and regulated industries.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Big-4 firms building quantum practices around quantum-safe migration show that PQC advisory is becoming a billable enterprise budget line.
insights.locator: EY has appointed Dr. Philip Intallura

insights.claim: Symmatrics added Andrew Hallman, a former senior US intelligence official and current Vice President at Leidos, to its Strategic Advisory Board to support its strategy for One-Time Pad Symmetric Key encryption in defense, intelligence and critical infrastructure. Hallman previously performed the duties of Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence at ODNI and was CIA Deputy Director for Digital Innovation.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A symmetric-key encryption startup recruiting intelligence-community insiders points to a push into government procurement channels.
insights.locator: Symmatrics has appointed veteran national security

themes.theme: Hardware and software company leadership changes

insights.claim: Zapata Quantum appointed MIT mathematician Peter Shor to its Scientific Advisory Board, along with Simon Devitt (UTS), Artur Izmaylov (University of Toronto) and Alexandru Paler (Aalto University). They join Austin Fowler, Jeff Grover and Alireza Shabani to guide the technical roadmap and algorithm development for Zapata's Quantum Pilot platform.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Adding the author of Shor's algorithm and fault-tolerance experts lends credibility to Zapata's algorithm roadmap, which is useful when judging its positioning against other quantum software vendors.
insights.locator: Zapata Quantum has appointed MIT mathematician

insights.claim: IQM Quantum Computers appointed Dr. Voica Radescu as Director of Commercial Partnerships. She spent nearly a decade at IBM leading IBM Quantum Innovation Centers across EMEA and APAC, and will drive commercial alliances and deployment strategy in Europe and international markets for IQM's on-premises and cloud-accessible systems.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: IQM hiring IBM's ecosystem builder signals a stronger commercial push for on-prem system sales in Europe and abroad.
insights.locator: IQM Quantum Computers has appointed Dr. Voica Radescu

insights.claim: Sparrow Quantum named founder and former Chief Quantum Officer Professor Peter Lodahl as CEO, succeeding Kurt Stokbro, who led the initial commercial scale-up and stays on as Executive Advisor and board member. Sparrow also launched a Scientific Advisory Board, with Professor Mark Saffman as a founding member, as it moves its deterministic single-photon hardware toward fault-tolerant photonic architectures and quantum interconnects.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Moving from a commercial CEO to a founder-scientist CEO suggests Sparrow is re-prioritizing deep R&D toward fault-tolerant photonics and interconnects.
insights.locator: Sparrow Quantum has appointed its founder
